resources.string: Open Aarogya to see which medicine this was.
If you can see and hear this, reminders are working on this phone.
Open Aarogya to restore your reminders
Aarogya could not read your reminder schedule, so some reminders may not arrive. Open the app once to restore them.
Could not record — open the app
Aarogya could not save your last response, most likely because this phone is out of storage. Open the app and record it there.
Aarogya is not allowed to set exact alarms on this phone, so reminders may be delayed. Open the app and run the Reminder Health Check.
